title: [BrightFoundry] staggered cohort promo codes — gating & budget approval
text:
[BrightFoundry] staggered cohort promo codes — gating & budget approval

['From: Lara Chen <partners@brightfoundry.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-05-03T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: staggered promo code release for BrightFoundry newsletter cohort

Hi Naomi / Marissa,

Thanks again for partnering with us for the May 20 community newsletter spotlight. We want to offer a limited set of Redwood trial credits to three newsletter cohorts (Early Access, General, Reengage) but need the codes released in staggered windows to avoid the early cohort burning the entire pool.

What we need from Redwood:
- 6,000 total trial-credit units (you can treat 1 unit = 1 trial access token for our tracking)
- Split across 3 cohorts: 2,000 / 2,000 / 2,000
- Staggered release schedule (cohort A at 9am PT, cohort B 24h later, cohort C 48h later)
- Per-cohort redemption cap and a simple webhook that fires to our endpoint on redemption for audit/logging
- Promo codes should expire after 60 days and be single-use

Attached: cohort_list_v1.csv (emails + segmentation tags) and gating_spec_draft.pdf (brief).

Can you confirm whether this is feasible from a platform & billing perspective, and if you need any more info (tracking parameters, HubSpot campaign id, legal T&Cs)? Also, what timeline do you need to generate and QA the code batches?

Appreciate it — we’re trying to coordinate the newsletter copy drop and want the codes live before May 18.

Best,
Lara Chen
Partner Programs — BrightFoundry Events

Attachments: cohort_list_v1.csv (CSV), gating_spec_draft.pdf (PDF)
', 'From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lara Chen <partners@brightfoundry.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-05-03T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: staggered promo code release for BrightFoundry newsletter cohort

Hi Lara — thanks for the clear brief and the attachments. This is doable but I want to align on two quick internal checks before we commit: budget/cap (finance) and tracking/HubSpot mapping (revops). Looping in Marcus and Kimberly to weigh in.

A few notes from platform ops:
- We can generate single-use promo batches and set per-batch redemption caps; we also support delayed release windows.
- We have a default 5k/day redemption safety throttle per partner; we can override that per-request but it requires explicit approval because of fraud/abuse risk.
- Webhook on redemption is supported. We’ll need your endpoint and a sample payload to validate.
- Expiry windows are configurable; finance may want shorter life for accounting — Kimberly?

Next steps I propose:
1) Marcus confirms HubSpot campaign linking and decides on redemption throttles + tracking params.
2) Kimberly confirms the credit cap and whether Accounting needs a PO or billed add-on.
3) We generate a test batch and share a QA checklist (link to tracking doc) by EOD 5/5 so you can smoke-test.

Lara — can you confirm the webhook URL + the preferred campaign id? If you prefer, we can also provide a small test payload and sandbox endpoint.

Naomi Feldman
Senior Partnerships Manager — Redwood Inference

Quoted: 
> Attached: cohort_list_v1.csv (CSV), gating_spec_draft.pdf (PDF)
', 'From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwoodinference.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lara Chen <partners@brightfoundry.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-05-03T11:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: staggered promo code release for BrightFoundry newsletter cohort

Naomi / team — quick revops notes:
- HubSpot campaign id confirmed: 6421 (BrightFoundry-newsletter-May20). I’ll add a UTM parameter template to the tracking doc.
- Throttle recommendation: keep per-batch cap at 2,500 redemptions and enable 24h delayed release windows as requested. That gives a safety headroom vs the 2,000 planned per cohort.
- We’ll implement three code namespaces (BF-A / BF-B / BF-C) and tag redemptions with campaign_id + cohort label so reporting is straightforward.
- I prepared an allocation_proposal.xlsx (attached) that outlines the batch names, expiration dates, and a short QA checklist for the test batch.

Action items for us:
- Naomi: confirm we should provision the full 6,000 now or provision 2,000 then top-up on-demand. Top-up requires a 1–2 hour ops window; provisioning all at once requires finance sign-off.
- Kimberly: can you confirm cap/budget? If we provision all at once, we mark it as a promotional credit on the next monthly usage report.

Marcus Lin
Revenue Operations — Redwood Inference

Attachments: allocation_proposal.xlsx
', 'From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwoodinference.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Lara Chen <partners@brightfoundry.com>
Date: 2026-05-04T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: staggered promo code release for BrightFoundry newsletter cohort

Team,

I reviewed the ask and the allocation proposal. Finance can provision up to 6,000 promo-credit units for this partner, with the following constraints:
- Final approval is conditional on BrightFoundry signing the partner promo T&C (DocuSign).
- Credits will be recorded as a promotional write-down on the May invoice; we need an internal memo for audit.
- Expiry: set to 45 days (not 60) — shorter expiry simplifies reconciliation for this promo window.
- We’ll require the redemption webhook logs and a CSV export after the campaign closes for our records.

If BrightFoundry signs the attached DocuSign (docusign_brightfoundry.pdf) by EOD 5/6, Finance will provision the full 6,000 credits on 5/18 and release batches per Marcus’s schedule. If they do not, provision will be staged in 2,000 increments pending PO.

Kimberly Park
Head of Finance — Redwood Inference

Attachment: docusign_brightfoundry.pdf (DocuSign T&C packet)
', 'From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lara Chen <partners@brightfoundry.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-05-04T14:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: staggered promo code release for BrightFoundry newsletter cohort

Hi Lara — quick update and next steps:

1) Finance (Kimberly) has provisionally approved 6,000 credits conditional on DocuSign T&Cs. I’ve attached the DocuSign packet.
2) RevOps (Marcus) will generate the three batch namespaces (BF-A / BF-B / BF-C), include UTM params, and default to a 2,500 redemption safety cap per batch.
3) We’ll set expiry to 45 days as requested by Finance.
4) Please sign the DocuSign by EOD 5/6 and confirm your webhook endpoint (send a test URL if possible).

Once signed, I’ll schedule a test batch for 5/12 and a full provision for 5/18, timed to your newsletter cadence. If you’d like us to stage 2,000 now and top-up automatically on hit, say so and we’ll implement the on-demand top-up workflow instead.

Thanks — Naomi
Senior Partnerships Manager — Redwood Inference

---
Forwarded attachments: allocation_proposal.xlsx; cohort_list_v1.csv; gating_spec_draft.pdf; docusign_brightfoundry.pdf
']
